title: Ticwatch 2 (Ticwear OS)
symptom: The user has a Ticwatch 2 running Ticwear OS (not Android Wear OS) and asks if there is any way to get the xDrip watchfaces pushed to the watch and communicate with the phone to get data, or even directly to the MioMio. They set up developer mode and the 1024 thing to sync apps but don't see the watch face anywhere.
evidence_quote: I have a Ticwatch 2 running Ticwear OS, not Android Wear OS. Is there any way to get the Xdrip watchfaces pushed to my Ticwatch 2 and communicate to my phone to get data (or even directly to my MioMio)? I set up developer mode and the 1024 thing to sync apps but don't see the watch face anywhere.
